note: A synthetic client (Slice 129 worked example). Not a real company.
problem: Our capital budget this year is $3,000,000 and two projects are competing for it.

answers.common.decision: Which project to fund this year; the CFO decides.
answers.common.deadline: The capital plan is due next month.
answers.common.audience: The CFO and the operating board.
answers.common.materials: An automated packing line costs $2,400,000 and would save $800,000 a year in labour. New warehouse racking costs $1,500,000 and would save $300,000 a year in storage. Our hurdle rate is 15%.
answers.finance-modeling.purpose: Compare the two projects' returns and fit them to the budget.
answers.finance-modeling.data: Project cost and savings estimates from the operations team, in US dollars.
